summary: ASX 200 hit a record high for a 2nd straight session (9,271.6, +0.47%) as gold equities surged (sub-index +11% over two sessions) and miners rallied on US-Iran peace hopes. Materials led (+1.11%); Real Estate lagged (-0.90%) into RBA week. RBA decides 11 Aug with ~97% hold priced. AMP +5.96% and REA +3.4% on results.
